cases.name: sparse-row
cases.covers: Sparse push payload (RFC §6.1): a partial row — id, a present-NULL title, and meta — over a 9-column table, so the 2-byte presence bitmap and the present-column null bitmap both carry padding bits

cases.name: sparse-row-full
cases.covers: The full-row special case: every presence bit set (incl. the second presence byte), a present-NULL title, and all nine §2.4 column types

invalid.name: presence-padding-bit
invalid.covers: Sparse row presence bitmap with a set padding bit (bit 9 of a 9-column table)

invalid.name: null-bit-for-absent-column
invalid.covers: Sparse row null bitmap with a set bit beyond the present columns — a null for an absent column

invalid.name: null-bit-on-non-nullable
invalid.covers: Sparse row null bit for the non-nullable primary-key column

invalid.name: absent-primary-key
invalid.covers: Sparse row whose presence bitmap omits the primary-key column (RFC §6.1)
